description: Game automation bot for Nostale. In-process engine + Tkinter GUI in a single Python script.
rules: The main script is 'autosp main branch v5.py'; it loads the backend 'autosp mainbranch v3.py' in-process via _load_backend().
Pickup naming callbacks run in BackendManager; read pickup data (_pickup_log, _pickup_names, _drop_items) via self.mgr, never self.
Do NOT modify 'autosp mainbranch v3.py' (loaded read-only).
Validate with: python -m py_compile "autosp main branch v5.py"
